problem_type: Anchored menu clipped by its trigger's ancestor
symptom: Clicking 3D Model or Whiteboard reaches the canvas instead of adding a node when the composer overlaps the dock.
direct_cause: The absolutely positioned menu is a child of the toolbar whose clip-path masks its descendants.
class_root: The expanded surface shares the clipped trigger's DOM ancestry. Independent tests of hole geometry and menu data miss the intersection.
affected_population: Creators adding space nodes while a selected node's composer overlaps the toolbar
RunningHub onboarding walks that add a model3d node
internal_only_reason: The dock, pointer routing and anchored overlay contract are defined in this repository.
invariants: Occlude the dock where it meets a composer while the expanded menu remains reachable.
A pick adds exactly one node of the requested kind and closes the menu.

door_reduction.why_not: The creation dock and navigation stack measure their own boxes. The editing dock and the empty-state starter both open the same creation menu.

generality_proof: Mounting the shared menu in AnchoredPopover takes every configured item at either entry out of the clipping subtree.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Hand the trigger and dismiss callback to the design system for portal placement, outside presses and focus.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The add button opens CanvasMoreAddMenu outside its clipped dock.
Its CanvasViewOptionsPopover already mounts through AnchoredPopover.
The starter uses the same menu anchored to its own button.

recurrence.reason: Every overlapping composer can clip any menu item outside the dock. Ancestor clipping previously hid timeline transition choices.
same_class_scan: door-map useCanvasChromeOcclusion identified the navigation stack and toolbar; door-map CanvasMoreAddMenu identified the toolbar and empty starter.
door-map CanvasToolbar identified React Flow and the design lab. The walk finds the menu from the page, and the gesture and context menu guards match role=menu or menuitem.

prevention.invariant: Every more-menu item is mounted through the shared design system portal.
prevention.failure_mode: The clipped dock retains its hit mask. The menu receives picks and passes the chosen intent to the canvas store.
prevention.strategy: Remove inline placement and document listeners, including trigger exclusions, from the shared menu.

legacy_paths.rationale: Deleted inline placements and the menu-owned document listeners at the shared creation menu.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: AnchoredPopover already owns the required behavior in the installed design system.

migration: Only transient DOM placement changes. Node storage, preferences, click actions and semantic selectors retain their existing contracts.
residual_risks: The onboarding walk exercises catalog browsing. Provider inference is outside the creation and selection path.

At baseline, tests/ux/canvas-control-clarity.walk.mjs scopes proveProbe and expectAbsent to the toolbar for portaled items. That walk is owned by an in-flight change and needs the page-scoped canvasAddMoreMenu locator.
